title: doc: explain inline 0x7F49 two-byte tag parsing in piv_generate_key()
description: wp11_proto_piv.c:933-945 -- the 0x7F49 tag is parsed inline with manual bounds checks rather than via tlv_expect(). A contributor will not know why. Add a brief comment: 'tlv_expect() handles only 1-byte tags; 0x7F49 is a two-byte constructed tag (ISO 7816-8 Table A.1), so it must be parsed manually here.' This prevents well-intentioned refactors that push it through tlv_expect() and silently break key generation.
